name: Housing Median Sales Prices
description: Median sales prices for various type of residential properties based on arms length, market rate sales. The data used to develop median prices comes from records filed at the Middlesex South Registry of Deeds. City staff analyze the records to identify arms-length sales. Arms-length sales are real-estate transactions in which two or more unrelated and unaffiliated parties agree to do business, acting independently and in their self-interest. Statistics drawn from only arms-length transactions are thought to best represent the true value of a property and state of the market.

name: American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates by Neighborhood: Housing Statistics
publisher_or_source: U.S. Census Bureau data aggregated by Cambridge Community Development Department
description:
This dataset provides housing information for Cambridge neighborhoods, based on 2020-2024 American Community Survey estimates.

Because the U.S. Census Bureau does not publish data at the geographic level of Cambridge neighborhoods, 2020 Census block groups were aggregated to approximate neighborhood boundaries. In most cases, block group boundaries align closely with neighborhood boundaries; however, there are notable discrepancies - especially in neighborhoods 10 (West Cambridge), 12 (Cambridge Highlands), and 13 (Strawberry Hill). For these neighborhoods in particular, the geographic boundary differences are significant, so interpret the aggregated data with extra caution.
stated_limitations: The American Community Survey is a sample based survey. All reported estimates are subject to measurable sampling error, which represents the difference between the measured value in the sample and the actual value across the entire population. name: Development Log Current Edition 2026 Q3
publisher_or_source: City of Cambridge Community Development Department
description:
The Development Log provides a record of large-scale development projects occurring in the City of Cambridge. The Log, updated on a quarterly basis, is distributed to City departments and the public to keep them posted about development progress, from permitting through construction to completion. The table includes general project information, such as development status and statistics related to the entire project. The Current Edition table lists all developments found in the last published edition of the Log, whose status range from In permitting to Complete in the then current calendar year. For projects completed in earlier calendar years see https://data.cambridgema.gov/Planning/Development-Log-Historical-Projects-Use-Data/r5mv-isth

Since a project may include more than one use, data on each specific use found within a project is found in the associated Development Log Project Use table. Found here: https://data.cambridgema.gov/Planning/Development-Log-Current-Edition-Project-Use-Data/5nqm-2ns2
